resources.string: Hold the Xiaomi filter tag against your phone. Its serial and counter will appear automatically.
This phone cannot read NFC tags. Use an Android phone with NFC.
Open NFC settings and switch NFC on. Then hold the filter tag against your phone.
Close other NFC apps and check NFC settings. Return to Filter Cleaner to scan again.
Keep the tag in position. This read does not write to the tag.
Keep the tag in position. Cleanup filter resets only the counter.
No usage is recorded. No reset is needed. This does not indicate the filter condition.
The counter was already zero. No data was written. The counter does not measure filter condition.
Keep the tag in position. Do not close the app.
The counter is verified as zero. Install the filter and check the purifier display.
The displayed tag data was cleared. Remove the tag, then touch it to your phone again. Keep it in position until the read is complete.
No reset command was sent. Keep the tag in position and tap Retry read. Authentication is not retried automatically.
No reset command was sent. Remove the tag, then touch it to your phone again to read the counter before another reset.

The counter on tag %1$s may have changed. Remove that tag, then touch it to your phone again for an automatic read. All resets stay disabled until that same tag is read successfully. A different tag cannot clear this requirement.
